globalStopConditions: Any unresolved Critical or High security finding
Any missing required provider right for a delivered field
Any missing signed legal applicability decision for an enabled territory or feature
Any failed tenant isolation, refund, rollback, incident recovery or entitlement check
Any stale, partial, conflicted or fixture evidence presented as LIVE
Any paid tier without measured incremental customer value and an exact SKU decision

discoveredGapLedger.title: Shield Pro fetched only the first 100 rows
discoveredGapLedger.closure: A bounded 250-row pagination loop walks up to 20 canonical pages, deduplicates exact IDs and stops only on a short final page.

discoveredGapLedger.title: A repeated provider page could create a false complete catalog
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Pagination detects a non-advancing page and returns an explicit partial blocker.

discoveredGapLedger.title: A later-page outage could erase the distinction between partial and complete coverage
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Rows already fetched are retained with mode=partial and an exact later-page failure blocker.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Shield Pro batch requests did not explicitly bind the free delivery tier
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Every catalog page sends tier=basic; paid depth remains a separate account-bound route.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Shield Map accepted unknown query parameters
discoveredGapLedger.closure: The server rejects every parameter outside query and locale.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Duplicate query or locale parameters could shadow identity
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Duplicate security-relevant parameters are rejected before provider work.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Shield Map query length, control and bidi characters were not centrally bounded
discoveredGapLedger.closure: A 120-byte strict query boundary and 2048-byte URL ceiling reject control and bidi input.

discoveredGapLedger.title: A fuzzy CoinGecko suggestion could be published as the requested asset
discoveredGapLedger.closure: CoinGecko output is used only when an integrity-valid provider receipt proves exact requested identity.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Ambiguous symbol or market resolution could continue to risk analysis
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Unresolved identity fails closed with HTTP 409 before investigator publication.

discoveredGapLedger.title: An EVM address could be accepted without an exact chain binding
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Address requests require exact address equality and a non-empty resolved chain ID.

discoveredGapLedger.title: A tampered provider identity receipt could authorize Shield Map
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Provider receipt integrity is recomputed before identity credit.

discoveredGapLedger.title: The Shield Map deep-dive toggle could be mistaken for paid analysis
discoveredGapLedger.closure: The response and UI contract fix deepDivePresentationOnly=true and VLM depth=basic.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Pro and Advanced delivery lacked one full-catalog entitlement proof
discoveredGapLedger.closure: All 636 paid packets remain blocked until a real server-owned account entitlement is verified.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Symbol-only inference could promote paid Shield Map depth
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Pro and Advanced map readiness require exact multi-source chain/address consensus.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Wallet or entity labels could be promoted without signed current evidence
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Advanced map readiness requires SIGNED_CURRENT labels; stale, conflict and missing stay blocked.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Investigator lane completeness lacked a full-catalog denominator
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Every tier packet binds all six lanes: supply, unlock, liquidity, insider, social and contract.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Shield Pro and Shield Map could drift on market identity
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Both surfaces bind the same canonical marketId, symbol and USD quote.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Terminal timeframe coverage was not proven across all tiers
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Six exact ranges are bound for every one of 954 tier packets.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Advanced could become ready on stale or conflicted order-book depth
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Paid terminal readiness requires AVAILABLE depth and preserves stale/conflict blockers.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Offline functional readiness could be mistaken for paid delivery
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Functional readiness and real delivery decisions are separate fields; paidDelivered remains zero.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Re-signed identity, binding, entitlement and depth mutations were not tested jointly
discoveredGapLedger.closure: Sixteen semantic mutation families are re-sealed for every tier packet and must fail verification.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Real Shield Pro/Map evidence had no exact denominator
discoveredGapLedger.closure: A fail-closed 318-asset intake requires pagination, identity, binding, labels, depth, browser, entitlement, rights and customer labels.

discoveredGapLedger.title: A85 could be promoted without an exact A80 candidate
discoveredGapLedger.closure: All A85 packets remain exactA80CandidateBound=false and ineligible for promotion.

discoveredGapLedger.title: Injected fixture evidence could be described as current public-network execution
discoveredGapLedger.closure: The runtime records zero real cases, browser assets, rights, entitlements and customer labels.
